title: Input naturality of the tensor localization model
statement: Let X be a scheme with a chosen derived category, and P,P',L complexes of module sheaves. For any chain map f:P→P', the tensor model localization maps μ(P,L) and μ(P',L) of [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison] satisfy (Qf tensor identity QL) followed by μ(P',L) = μ(P,L) followed by Q(mapBifunctorMap(f,identity L)). No K-flatness or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 06YH and 08DJ; canonical derived tensor localization map

proof.text: Use the shared local instances from pullbackTensorModelMap, which is μ of the lax monoidal localization Q. Apply Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural to f and identity L. Rewrite Q(identity L) as identity QL and the complex tensor map as mapBifunctorMap f (identity L). This is the stated equation. It does not use invertibility of μ or K-flatness.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06YH; lax monoidal localization tensor comparison

lean.statement:
theorem tensorModelMap_input_natural (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (P P' L : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (f : P ⟶ P') :
    let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    let := schemeDerivedTensorMonoidal X
    (DerivedCategory.Q.map f ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)) ≫
        pullbackTensorModelMap X P' L =
      pullbackTensorModelMap X P L ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f (𝟙 L)
          (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ))
